subject: Re: SOC 2 / SIG evidence & pen test follow-up: authn/logging/network remediations
messages:
From: Liam O'Neill <liam.oneill@redteamlabs.com>
To: Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.com>, David Kim <david_kim@redwood.com>
Cc: security-team@acme-retail.com
Date: Tue, 4 Nov 2025 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Initial delivery: redteam findings + ask for SOC2/SIG evidence

Hi Irene / David,

Attached is the RedTeam Labs (RTL) assessment we completed last week for the Acme Retail engagement (redacted for public distribution). High-level findings relevant to SOC 2 / SIG that I want to highlight:

- Critical: auth bypass via legacy SSO token handling (Auth Service)
- High: insufficient session detail in application logs (missing session IDs / user context)
- High: overly permissive egress rule to third-party storage (S3 exposure)
- Medium: secrets embedded in build artifacts (CI pipeline)

Can you provide:
1) A short remediation plan (bullet ETA for each finding) so we can schedule re-test windows.
2) Evidence items we can attach to Acme's SIG/SOC2 package (log snippet samples, PRs, config changes, or screenshots).
3) Point person for technical walkthrough next week.

Attachments:
- RTL_full_report_redacted.pdf (PDF, 4.2MB)

Thanks,
Liam O'Neill
Senior Tester, RedTeam Labs
liam.oneill@redteamlabs.com
+1 415-555-0192

On Tue, Nov 4, 2025 at 09:12 AM Liam O'Neill <liam.oneill@redteamlabs.com> wrote: [see attached report]
From: Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.com>
To: Liam O'Neill <liam.oneill@redteamlabs.com>
Cc: David Kim <david_kim@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 4 Nov 2025 11:05:32 -0700
Subject: Re: Initial delivery: redteam findings + ask for SOC2/SIG evidence

Hi Liam — thanks for the report and the clear call-outs. We're prioritizing the critical/high items and I wanted to share an initial remediation roadmap and evidence handoff plan.

Quick answers to your asks:
- Point person for walkthrough: Karthik (cc'd) for technical detail; I'll coordinate scheduling with Acme.
- Evidence drop: we'll share a remediation tracker + a short bundle of config snippets/screenshots.

Topline remediation plan (high level):
- Auth bypass (Auth Service): immediate mitigation = disable legacy SSO token acceptance; patch PR targeted this week. Full fix (auth-service hardening + test coverage) targeted in two sprints.
- Logging: add session-id to all front-end and API logs, ship to centralized ELK, and retain 90 days for SOC2 evidence.
- Network: tighten egress, add deny-by-default rules to the S3 bucket paths; will stage in staging then prod.
- Secrets: blocklist and rotate any exposed keys found in artifacts, add pre-commit secret scan in CI.

I'll attach the remediation tracker (initial) and a short remediation plan doc. Expect a fuller technical note from Karthik tomorrow.

Attachments:
- remediation_tracker_v1.xlsx (XLSX, 45KB)
- remediation_plan_v2.md (MD, 8KB)

Thanks — I'll follow up with proposed times for the walkthrough.

Best,
Irene Choi
Director, Security & Compliance
Redwood Inference
irene_choi@redwood.com
+1 650-555-0136
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Liam O'Neill <liam.oneill@redteamlabs.com>, Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 5 Nov 2025 09:30:15 -0700
Subject: Re: Initial delivery: redteam findings + ask for SOC2/SIG evidence

Hi Liam — thanks for the clear report. Below is a technical triage and proposed ETAs for remediation + evidence. I'll be the point for the technical walkthrough.

Triage & ETA (conservative estimates):
- Auth bypass (Auth Service) — root cause: legacy token validation allowed unsigned tokens when migrating SSO schemas.
  * Mitigation (today): reject legacy tokens at the proxy layer (already rolled to canary in staging)
  * Code fix: auth-service PR #6782 (hardening + unit tests) -> canary deploy 2025-11-12 -> full prod 2025-11-18
  * Evidence to provide: PR diff, unit/integration test output, canary deployment logs, post-fix RTL retest request

- Logging (session context) — root cause: logging middleware doesn't surface session_id for API calls originated from mobile clients.
  * Fix: middleware update + ELK ingestion mapping -> staging 2025-11-10 -> prod 2025-11-13
  * Evidence: sample log lines (pre/post), ELK index config, retention policy screenshot

- Network (S3 egress)
  * Mitigation: apply deny-by-default egress rule to the VPC for the affected subnet (planned 2025-11-09)
  * Prod enforcement window: 2025-11-20 (after testing with partner integrators)
  * Evidence: security group rule diff, VPC flow logs snippets, S3 ACL/Policy snapshot

- Secrets in CI artifacts
  * Mitigation: rotate detected keys and invalidate stale tokens (in-progress)
  * Long-term: add pre-commit secret scanning and artifact scanning; rollout by 2025-11-25
  * Evidence: CI job logs, rotated key identifiers (redacted), SR ticket IDs

Notes on SOC2 / SIG evidence packaging: we will bundle a short evidence pack per finding (PRs, logs, screenshots, and a remediation summary) and place it in the shared Drive folder. I recommend scheduling RTL retest windows for 2025-11-21 through 2025-11-25.

Attachments referenced: remediation_plan_v2.md (contains links to PRs and required snippets).

Looking forward to the walkthrough; propose Thu 2025-11-06 10:00am PST or Fri 11/07 3:00pm PST.

Thanks,
Karthik
Staff Software Engineer, Prod Infra
karthik_iyer@redwood.com
From: Liam O'Neill <liam.oneill@redteamlabs.com>
To: Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: Claire Zhang <claire.zhang@acme-retail.com>, security-team@acme-retail.com
Date: Thu, 6 Nov 2025 15:20:42 -0700
Subject: Re: Initial delivery: redteam findings + ask for SOC2/SIG evidence

Thanks for the rapid turnaround — the plan reads well and the ETAs are reasonable. A couple of asks before we schedule the retest window:

1) For SOC2 evidence we need a) a log-retention policy document or configuration screenshot that shows 90-day retention, and b) an example of a centralized log line that includes the new session_id mapping (redacted).
2) For the auth fix please provide the canary deployment logs and a short summary of rollback procedures (we need to confirm safe reversion if the hardening causes regressions).
3) For the network change, can you provide a test plan that shows how you'll validate partner integrations will not be blocked by the tightened egress rules?

Also attaching a short checklist so Acme's security team can track accepted evidence items.

Attachments:
- requested_evidence_checklist.csv (CSV, 2KB)

If you can drop the initial evidence bundle into the shared Drive folder by EOD Friday (2025-11-07) we'll aim to kick retests the following week.

Regards,
Liam
From: Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.com>
To: Liam O'Neill <liam.oneill@redteamlabs.com>, Claire Zhang <claire.zhang@acme-retail.com>

Subject: Re: Initial delivery: redteam findings + ask for SOC2/SIG evidence

Liam / Claire — thanks, all. Short status and commitments below (consolidated for Acme):

Committed deliverables & ETAs (final):
- Auth hardening: canary logs + PR diff -> shared Drive by 2025-11-12; full prod completion 2025-11-18.
- Logging evidence: sample pre/post log lines + ELK retention screenshot -> Drive by 2025-11-13.
- Network egress: test plan + security group diffs + VPC flow log snippets -> Drive by 2025-11-09; prod enforcement 2025-11-20.
- Secrets remediation: rotated keys summary + CI job logs -> Drive by 2025-11-14.

Walkthrough: Karthik will run a technical walkthrough on Fri 2025-11-07 at 3:00pm PST (meeting invite to follow).

Retest window request: please plan RTL retests for 2025-11-21 to 2025-11-25; we'll confirm exact slots after we drop evidence.

Links / evidence bundle (will be populated):
